news.titleEn: SoftBank Shares Slide 13% After AI Chiefs Sound Alarm on Safety
news.conclusionEn: SoftBank shares plunged more than 13% in Tokyo, their steepest one-day drop since June, after Anthropic and OpenAI's chief executives called for slowing frontier AI development and Sam Altman said an OpenAI IPO this year would be unwise.
news.conclusionZh: AI巨头呼吁放缓开发，软银股价单日暴跌逾13%。
news.whyEn: SoftBank has committed nearly $65 billion to OpenAI and was counting on an IPO to convert that stake into tradable value; the delay leaves it exposed, and the selloff dragged down chip stocks across Asia.
news.whyZh: 软银押注OpenAI近650亿美元，IPO推迟令持仓难变现，拖累亚洲芯片股齐跌。
news.detailEn: Shares of SoftBank Group fell more than 13% in Tokyo trading on Monday, its worst single-day decline since late June, after Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published an essay on September 12 titled 'We Must Pace the Frontier,' urging AI companies to deliberately slow the pace of capability gains, with OpenAI's Sam Altman and Tesla's Elon Musk voicing support. Altman also said pursuing an OpenAI IPO this year would be 'ill-advised,' a comment that hit SoftBank especially hard because its roughly $65 billion investment in OpenAI depends on a future listing to become a tradable, valued stake. The selloff spread across the region, with Japanese chipmakers Kioxia and Advantest falling 9.3% and 4.9% respectively, and South Korea's SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics both dropping more than 3%. Nasdaq 100 futures fell over 1% and S&P 500 futures slid 0.6% as US markets braced to open lower.
news.detailZh: 周一东京交易时段，软银集团股价重挫逾13%，创6月以来最大单日跌幅，起因是Anthropic首席执行官Dario Amodei于9月12日发表题为《我们必须把控前沿节奏》的文章，呼吁AI公司主动放缓能力提升速度，OpenAI的Sam Altman和特斯拉的埃隆·马斯克均表态支持。Altman还表示，今年推进OpenAI上市将是「不明智的」，这一表态对软银打击尤其严重，因为其对OpenAI约650亿美元的投资依赖未来上市才能转化为可交易、可估值的资产。抛售情绪蔓延至整个亚太地区，日本芯片厂商铠侠和爱德万测试分别下跌9.3%和4.9%，韩国SK海力士与三星电子跌幅均超3%。纳斯达克100指数期货下跌逾1%，标普500指数期货下滑0.6%，美股开盘前承压。

news.titleEn: Iran-Gulf talks without US participation on reopening the Strait of Hormuz postponed
news.conclusionEn: A planned meeting between Iran and Gulf states in Oman to negotiate reopening the Strait of Hormuz to normal tanker traffic was postponed indefinitely, Oman's foreign minister said, dimming hopes for near-term relief in oil markets.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗与海湾国家原定的霍尔木兹海峡谈判被无限期推迟。
news.whyEn: About a fifth of global oil supply passes through the Strait of Hormuz, which has been disrupted since the war between the US and Iran began; a delayed resolution keeps upward pressure on oil prices and inflation worldwide.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹海峡承载全球约五分之一原油运输，谈判受阻将持续推高油价与通胀。
news.detailEn: Gulf diplomats and Iranian officials were scheduled to meet on Monday in Salalah, Oman, to discuss an Omani-brokered plan for reopening the Strait of Hormuz to regular tanker traffic, but Omani Foreign Minister Badr Albusaidi announced on social media that the meeting had been postponed 'in the interests of consensus.' The strait, through which roughly a fifth of the world's oil supply flows, has been disrupted since fighting between the US and Israel against Iran escalated earlier this year, pushing crude prices above $100 a barrel. Iran and Oman had spent weeks negotiating a temporary corridor and agreeing on shipping routes, and the Trump administration has reviewed the framework but not formally endorsed it. Analysts warned that without a deal on Hormuz, oil markets will remain volatile, especially as Houthi advances near the Bab el-Mandeb Strait add a second chokepoint risk on the Red Sea side.
news.detailZh: 海湾国家外交官与伊朗官员原定周一在阿曼萨拉拉举行会谈，讨论一项由阿曼牵头、旨在恢复霍尔木兹海峡正常油轮通行的方案，但阿曼外交大臣巴德尔·布赛迪在社交媒体上宣布，该会议「为寻求共识」而推迟举行。这条承载全球约五分之一原油运输的海峡，自美国和以色列今年早些时候对伊朗的战事升级以来一直受阻，导致原油价格一度突破每桶100美元。伊朗与阿曼此前已就临时通行走廊和具体航线磋商数周，特朗普政府虽审阅了相关方案框架，但尚未正式表态支持。分析师警告，若霍尔木兹问题得不到解决，加上胡塞武装在红海一侧逼近曼德海峡带来的第二重咽喉要道风险，油价市场仍将持续动荡。

news.titleEn: Fed to hold rates steady in rest of 2026; rising number of analysts see at least one hike: Reuters poll
news.conclusionEn: The Federal Reserve begins its two-day policy meeting on September 15, with a Reuters poll showing most economists still expect rates to hold at 3.50%-3.75%, though a fast-growing minority now expects a hike given persistent inflation.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储9月15日起议息，多数经济学家预期维持利率不变，但预期加息比例上升。
news.whyEn: The meeting includes updated economic projections and a rate decision that will ripple through global borrowing costs, currencies and stock valuations, with markets currently pricing meaningful odds of a surprise hike.
news.whyZh: 本次会议将公布利率决议及经济预测，牵动全球借贷成本、汇率与股市估值。
news.detailEn: The Federal Reserve's Federal Open Market Committee meets September 15-16, with the rate decision due Wednesday afternoon followed by a press conference from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. A Reuters poll conducted September 4-9 found about 70% of the 93 economists surveyed expect the federal funds rate to stay in its current 3.50%-3.75% range, down from 90% in a similar poll in August, while the rest now expect a quarter-point hike, which would be the first increase since July 2023. The shift follows a hawkish Jackson Hole speech from Warsh and stronger-than-expected producer price data, even though headline consumer inflation has eased slightly to 3.4% annually. Financial markets are pricing the odds of a hike even higher than the economist poll, and the meeting will also produce an updated 'dot plot' of policymakers' rate expectations, giving investors a clearer signal on the path for 2027.
news.detailZh: 美联储联邦公开市场委员会将于9月15日至16日召开会议，利率决议将于周三下午公布，随后美联储主席凯文·沃什将召开新闻发布会。路透社9月4日至9日对93位经济学家进行的调查显示，约70%的受访者预计联邦基金利率将维持在当前3.50%至3.75%区间，低于8月同类调查中90%的比例，其余经济学家则预期将加息25个基点，这将是自2023年7月以来的首次加息。这一转变发生在沃什在杰克逊霍尔发表鹰派讲话、以及生产者价格数据超预期走高之后，尽管居民消费价格年率已略微降至3.4%。金融市场对加息概率的定价甚至高于经济学家调查结果，此次会议还将公布最新的利率预期「点阵图」，为投资者提供2027年利率路径的更清晰信号。

news.titleEn: BRICS summit 2026: What are the key takeaways?
news.conclusionEn: The 18th BRICS summit concluded in New Delhi with the 11-member bloc adopting a 140-point New Delhi Declaration on trade, technology and global governance, while avoiding direct mention of the Ukraine war.
news.conclusionZh: 第18届金砖峰会闭幕，通过140条《新德里宣言》，未点名提及乌克兰战争。
news.whyEn: With members representing a large share of global population and GDP including China, India, Russia and Saudi Arabia, the bloc's positions on sanctions, trade and Palestine carry weight for global governance debates and Western-led sanctions regimes.
news.whyZh: 金砖国家占全球人口与经济体量巨大，其立场影响全球治理与对俄制裁格局。
news.detailEn: The 18th BRICS Summit ran September 12-13 in New Delhi, hosted by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, with the expanded 11-member grouping including Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa, Egypt, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Iran, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. Leaders adopted the New Delhi Declaration, a 140-point document addressing trade, technology cooperation and reform of global governance institutions, and expressed 'firm opposition' to the forced displacement of Palestinians from the occupied territories. On Ukraine, the declaration issued only a generic call for disputes to be resolved through dialogue rather than naming the conflict directly, reflecting divisions within the bloc, while member states criticized unilateral sanctions not authorized by the UN Security Council. On the sidelines, Russian President Vladimir Putin held bilateral talks with Modi and warned that any European troop deployment to Ukraine would amount to war with Russia. The next summit is scheduled to be held in China in 2027.
news.detailZh: 第18届金砖国家峰会于9月12日至13日在新德里举行，由印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪主持，扩员后的11个成员国包括巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国、南非、埃及、埃塞俄比亚、印度尼西亚、伊朗、沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋。各国领导人通过了《新德里宣言》，这份长达140条的文件涉及贸易、技术合作及全球治理机构改革议题，并对巴勒斯坦人在被占领土上遭强制驱离表达「坚决反对」。在乌克兰问题上，宣言仅笼统呼吁通过对话解决争端，未直接点名这场冲突，反映出集团内部的分歧，成员国同时批评未经联合国安理会授权的单边制裁。峰会期间，俄罗斯总统普京与莫迪举行双边会谈，并警告称欧洲若向乌克兰派兵将等同于对俄开战。下届峰会将于2027年在中国举行。

news.titleEn: Israeli attack on Gaza kills two Palestinians
news.conclusionEn: An Israeli air strike on a vehicle in Gaza City's Tal al-Hawa neighborhood killed at least two Palestinians and wounded 13, the latest in near-daily attacks despite the ceasefire agreed with Hamas last October.
news.conclusionZh: 以军空袭加沙城致2人死亡13人受伤，停火协议下袭击仍近乎每日发生。
news.whyEn: Continued strikes despite a formal ceasefire raise doubts about the durability of the truce and complicate reconstruction and aid efforts in Gaza, with implications for regional stability and US-brokered diplomacy.
news.whyZh: 停火后袭击持续，令停火协议可信度受质疑，影响加沙重建与地区外交进程。
news.detailEn: Israeli forces struck a vehicle in Gaza City's Tal al-Hawa neighborhood on Sunday, killing at least two people and wounding 13, according to Palestinian medics; the Israeli military said it had targeted two Hamas fighters. The strike is the latest in a pattern of near-daily Israeli attacks on Gaza since a ceasefire between Israel and Hamas took effect in October last year. According to Gaza's Government Media Office, Israel has violated the ceasefire more than 4,300 times since it began, with strikes killing over 1,270 people in that period. The continued violence comes even as US-brokered diplomatic efforts, including a recent visit by White House adviser Jared Kushner, have sought to stabilize the truce and advance reconstruction plans for the territory.
news.detailZh: 以色列军队周日在加沙城塔勒哈瓦街区空袭一辆车辆，造成至少2人死亡、13人受伤，巴勒斯坦医护人员证实了这一消息；以色列军方表示袭击目标是两名哈马斯武装人员。此次袭击是自去年10月以色列与哈马斯停火协议生效以来，加沙近乎每日遭袭模式的最新一例。据加沙政府媒体办公室统计，停火以来以方已违反协议逾4300次，期间造成逾1270人死亡。尽管包括白宫顾问贾里德·库什纳近期访问在内的美方斡旋外交努力一直试图稳固停火并推进加沙重建计划，但暴力仍在持续。

news.titleEn: The U.S. Senate Faces a Critical Vote on the Clarity Act on Sept. 15
news.conclusionEn: The US Senate is set to hold a cloture vote on the CLARITY Act crypto market-structure bill on September 15, needing 60 votes including at least seven Democrats to overcome a filibuster and advance the legislation.
news.conclusionZh: 美国参议院9月15日就加密货币监管法案CLARITY Act进行程序性投票。
news.whyEn: The bill would set the first comprehensive US rules for classifying and regulating digital assets; its fate hinges on unresolved disputes over stablecoin yields and ethics rules, and failure would stall major crypto legislation into 2027.
news.whyZh: 该法案将首次系统规范美国数字资产监管，投票结果关乎加密行业未来立法进程。
news.detailEn: The Senate scheduled a cloture vote for 2:15 p.m. ET on Tuesday, September 15, on the CLARITY Act, a comprehensive crypto market-structure bill; the procedural vote requires 60 votes to end debate and move toward a final passage vote, meaning Republicans need at least seven Democrats to cross over given their 53-seat majority. Senate Democratic leader Chuck Schumer convened his caucus on September 13 to discuss the bill, while President Trump met advisers days earlier to work through disputed ethics language concerning digital-asset holdings by federal officials. Three provisions remain the main sticking points: an ethics clause targeting officials' crypto sponsorships, a section on DeFi developer liability, and a proposed ban on stablecoin interest payments that pits crypto issuers against traditional banks. Prediction markets have priced the odds of the bill becoming law in 2026 at around 22%, down sharply from earlier optimism this year.
news.detailZh: 参议院已将CLARITY Act加密货币市场结构法案的程序性投票定于9月15日周二美东时间下午2点15分举行；该投票需要60票以终结辩论、推进最终表决，鉴于共和党仅占53个席位，意味着至少需要7名民主党参议员倒戈支持。参议院民主党领袖舒默于9月13日召集党团商讨该法案，而特朗普总统数日前已与顾问会面，试图解决有关联邦官员持有数字资产的伦理条款争议。目前主要分歧集中在三处：针对官员加密货币赞助行为的伦理条款、去中心化金融开发者责任相关章节，以及一项禁止稳定币支付利息的提案——该提案令加密发行方与传统银行业形成对立。预测市场目前将该法案在2026年内成法的概率定价在约22%，较年初的乐观预期大幅下滑。

news.titleEn: 'The days of safety are over': Russian airports face record closures
news.conclusionEn: Russian airports were temporarily closed 993 times in August alone, an average of 32 closures a day at 32 airports including Moscow and St Petersburg, as Ukraine's intensifying drone campaign disrupts civil aviation across Russia.
news.conclusionZh: 俄罗斯8月机场临时关闭993次，乌克兰无人机战令俄民航持续中断。
news.whyEn: The unprecedented scale of airspace disruption is straining Russian airlines, insurers and passengers, and signals Ukraine's growing capability to impose economic costs deep inside Russian territory, beyond the front line.
news.whyZh: 空域中断规模空前，冲击俄航空业与保险市场，凸显乌克兰打击纵深能力提升。
news.detailEn: Russian airports were forced to temporarily close a record 993 times in August, an average of 32 closures per day across 32 airports including Moscow's major hubs and St Petersburg, as Ukrainian drone strikes and the threat of them repeatedly triggered Russia's 'Kover' emergency air-defense protocol, which grounds or diverts civil aircraft when a drone threat is detected. The closures mark a sharp escalation from earlier in the year and already exceed the total disruptions recorded across all of 2025. President Volodymyr Zelensky has warned airlines, insurers and foreign governments that Russian airspace 'will be de facto closed' due to the intensity of Ukraine's drone operations, a campaign Kyiv says is aimed at pressuring Russia's economy and military logistics. The disruptions have forced repeated flight cancellations, delays and diversions for major carriers including Aeroflot and S7, adding to the economic strain on Russia as the war continues with no ceasefire in sight.
news.detailZh: 俄罗斯机场8月份被迫临时关闭多达993次，创下纪录，平均每天在包括莫斯科主要枢纽和圣彼得堡在内的32座机场关闭32次，原因是乌克兰无人机袭击及其威胁反复触发俄罗斯代号「Kover」（意为「地毯」）的紧急防空协议，该协议在探测到无人机威胁时会使民航客机停飞或改道。此轮关闭潮较今年早些时候大幅升级，累计中断次数已超过2025年全年总和。乌克兰总统泽连斯基已警告各国航空公司、保险商及外国政府，称由于乌方无人机行动力度加大，俄罗斯领空「实质上将被关闭」，基辅方面表示此举旨在向俄罗斯经济及军事后勤施压。这些中断已导致俄罗斯航空、西伯利亚航空等主要航司频繁取消、延误和改道航班，在战事仍无停火迹象之际进一步加重俄罗斯经济负担。

businessTips.explanationEn: Second-order thinking means asking not just 'what happens next' but 'and then what happens after that,' pushing decision-makers past the obvious first consequence of a choice to its downstream ripple effects. Most people default to first-order thinking, which favors options that look good immediately but can create bigger problems later, such as cutting prices to win market share without considering how competitors and customers will react. Practicing second-order thinking usually means mapping out at least two or three steps of consequences before committing to a decision, and asking who else will react and how. It is especially valuable in competitive, interconnected situations like pricing, hiring, and policy changes, where an obvious short-term win can trigger a worse long-term outcome.
businessTips.explanationZh: 二阶思维不仅问「接下来会发生什么」，还要追问「然后呢」，促使决策者跳出选择带来的显而易见的第一层后果，去思考随之而来的连锁反应。多数人习惯于一阶思维，倾向选择短期内看起来不错的方案，却可能埋下更大隐患，比如为抢占市场份额而降价，却没考虑竞争对手和客户会如何随之反应。运用二阶思维通常意味着在做决定前，至少推演两三步的后续影响，并思考还有谁会做出反应、会如何反应。这种思维方式在定价、招聘、政策调整等相互关联、竞争激烈的场景中尤其有价值，因为看似明显的短期获益，可能引发更糟糕的长期后果。
businessTips.exampleEn: A software company considers offering a steep discount to a big client to close a deal quickly. Applying second-order thinking, the sales team realizes that other clients will hear about the discount and demand the same price, and that the client may expect further discounts at renewal, so they instead offer a smaller discount tied to a longer contract term.
businessTips.exampleZh: 一家软件公司考虑给某大客户大幅折扣以尽快成交。运用二阶思维后，销售团队意识到其他客户得知后也会要求同等折扣，且该客户续约时可能还会要求进一步降价，于是改为提供较小幅度折扣，但绑定更长的合同期限。

businessTips.explanationEn: A Minimum Viable Product is the simplest version of a product or service that still delivers enough value to attract real customers and generate honest feedback, without building every feature founders imagine it eventually needs. The goal is to test core assumptions about whether people actually want and will pay for the idea before investing significant time and money into a fully polished version. This approach reduces the risk of spending months building something nobody wants, since real user behavior, not opinions or surveys, reveals what to build next. For side hustles especially, an MVP can be as simple as a manually delivered service or a basic landing page that collects orders before the product even exists.
businessTips.explanationZh: 最小可行产品（MVP）是指产品或服务的最简版本，它虽然功能有限，但足以吸引真实客户并获得真实反馈，而不必一开始就把创始人设想中的所有功能都做出来。其核心目的是在投入大量时间和资金打磨完整版本之前，先验证人们是否真的想要、也愿意为这个想法付费这一关键假设。这种做法能大幅降低「辛苦几个月却做出没人要的东西」的风险，因为真实用户行为远比意见或问卷调查更能说明接下来该做什么。对副业项目而言，MVP甚至可以简单到只是一项人工提供的服务，或是一个在产品尚未真正存在时就先收集订单的落地页。
businessTips.exampleEn: Before building a full mobile app for a personalized meal-planning side business, the founder starts by manually creating meal plans in a spreadsheet and emailing them to the first 20 paying customers found through a simple landing page. Only after confirming people will pay and stay subscribed does she invest in building actual software to automate the process.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在为个性化配餐副业开发完整手机应用之前，创始人先用一份表格手动制定食谱，并通过一个简单的落地页找到最初20名付费客户，把方案手动发邮件给他们。只有在确认用户愿意付费并持续订阅后，她才投入资金开发真正的软件来实现流程自动化。

businessTips.explanationEn: Duration measures how sensitive a bond's price is to changes in interest rates: the higher a bond's duration, the more its price will fall when rates rise, and the more it will gain when rates fall. Long-term bonds and those with lower coupon payments generally have higher duration, making them riskier to hold heading into a central bank decision, while short-term bonds and cash-like instruments have low duration and are comparatively insulated. Investors watch duration closely around events like Federal Reserve meetings, because even a small, unexpected rate move can cause outsized price swings in long-duration bond portfolios. Managing duration risk typically means shortening bond maturities or diversifying across different maturities when rate uncertainty is high, rather than concentrating in long-dated bonds.
businessTips.explanationZh: 久期用于衡量债券价格对利率变动的敏感程度：久期越高，利率上升时价格跌得越多，利率下降时价格也涨得越多。期限较长、票息较低的债券通常久期更高，在央行做出利率决议前持有风险更大；而短期债券和类现金工具久期较低，相对更能抵御利率波动冲击。投资者在美联储议息会议等重大事件前后会密切关注久期，因为即便利率出现小幅意外变动，也可能给久期较长的债券组合带来幅度惊人的价格波动。管理久期风险的常见做法是在利率不确定性较高时缩短债券期限或分散配置不同期限的债券，而不是集中持有长期债券。
businessTips.exampleEn: With the Fed's September meeting seen as a toss-up between holding rates and a surprise hike, a bond investor holding mostly 20-year Treasury bonds faces much larger potential price swings than one holding a mix of short-term Treasury bills. Anticipating volatility around the decision, the investor shifts part of the portfolio into shorter-duration bonds to reduce how much a rate surprise could hurt their overall returns.
businessTips.exampleZh: 在美联储9月议息会议加息与否悬而未决之际，主要持有20年期美国国债的投资者，比持有短期国库券组合的投资者面临大得多的潜在价格波动。为应对决议前后的不确定性，该投资者将部分仓位转向久期较短的债券，以降低利率意外变动对整体收益的冲击。
